Our work environment helps individuals explore their interests and potential and reach out to the resources and people available at Soliton to realize them. Read more about what it's like to work at Soliton: Soliton Employee Value Proposition .
* Solitons choose their work hours as long as it takes into account the requirements of the job. We take special care to support mothers to excel at work while they handle their responsibilities at home.
* At Soliton, we believe that every team member contributes to our success and revenue, directly or indirectly. To recognize this, we share a portion of our profits with all Solitons. Starting from your second year with us, you'll be eligible to receive a share of the company's profits.
* Health insurance for employees and families, gym and cycle allowance – your health is a priority!



  





**About Soliton:** 




 Soliton Technologies Pvt. Ltd., a high\-technology software company headquartered in Bangalore, India.

 At Quantcast, we craft offers that reflect your unique skills, expertise, and geographic location. title: Quality Supervisor
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Quality Assurance supervisor develops, implements, and maintains technical quality assurance and control systems to ensure product reliability and compliance with company standards. This role defines inspection methods, testing procedures, and quality benchmarks, while contributing to engineering design reviews and supporting product data analysis. You will lead a team of professionals to achieve operational excellence in quality systems.
   

  

 Will support and meet the objectives and goals of Quality Engineering and the Oragadam Facility. Provide training and leadership for Corrective Action Teams and Work Groups. Maintain IMS Quality Systems and requirements. Provide the liaison between Quality Engineering and other departments in support of quality and manufacturing initiatives. This is a leadership position to include resolution of ETO panel quality issues, data support, correction and corrective action. Ensure Good through familiarity with policies and procedures relating to standards of business conduct.
   

  

 You will report to QUALITY AND PROJECT TRANSFER MANAGER.
   

  

 You will work in Onsite work mode based in our Chennai plant in Kancheepuram, India
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Establish and maintain quality assurance systems, standards, and procedures.
* Define inspection and testing methods to evaluate precision, accuracy, and reliability of products.
* Review engineering designs to integrate quality requirements and considerations.
* Support product teams by gathering and analysing production \& quality\-related challenges.
* Supervise and develop personnel to ensure efficient operation of the quality function.
* Provide direction to employees in line with company policies and objectives.
* Act as advisor to the team, actively engaging to meet schedules and resolve problems.
* Build productive internal and external working relationships through collaboration and presentations.
* Drive Quality improvements continually to achieve manufacturing quality KPI target.
* Manage Customer and third\-party audits.
* Problem solving (root cause failure analysis) and taking corrective action to Operational challenges.
* Analyze field return information for areas of quality improvement if needed.
* Provide Quality Engineering technical evaluation with Design of Experiments and Process Capability studies.
* Take the role of quality continuous improvement \& process excellence.
* Conduct tasks in accordance with applicable health, safety, quality and environmental regulations (state regulations, ISO 9000, ISO 14000, etc.) as well as Rockwell Automation policies and procedures.


**The Essentials \- You Will Have**
* B.E – Mechanical / Electrical \& Electronics Engineering.
* 10\+ years of experience.
* Command of the English Language – Oral and written.
* ISO 9001,14001,45001 – Lead auditor, Exposure on Lean / Six Sigma.


**The Preferred \- You Might Also Have**
**Core Technical Competencies**
* Quality Systems Management – Ability to design, implement, and maintain QA/QC systems.
* Inspection \& Testing Methods – Knowledge of standards, procedures, and tools for evaluating product precision and reliability.
* Data Analysis – Skill in gathering, interpreting, and using quality data to drive improvements.
* Manufacturing Knowledge – Understanding of production processes and compliance standards.


**Leadership \& Supervisory Competencies**
* Team Management – Direct supervision of professionals and experienced contributors.
* Coaching \& Development – Ability to select, train, and evaluate personnel for efficiency.
* Decision\-Making – Exercising judgment within defined policies and procedures.
* Conflict Resolution – Addressing issues and resolving problems to meet schedules.
* Performance Management – Setting objectives, monitoring progress, and ensuring goal achievement.


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Presenting technical information clearly to peers, subordinates, and customers.
* Collaboration \& Establishing productive internal and external working relationships.
* Policy Application – Applying company policies consistently to resolve varied issues.
* Customer Orientation – Engaging with customers to ensure quality expectations are met.


**Managerial Competencies**
* Strategic Alignment – Translating company objectives into actionable quality goals.
* Process Improvement – Identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency and reliability.
* Accountability – Ensuring compliance with standards and delivering measurable outcomes beyond boundary.


**What We Offer**

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm.

* Employee Assistance Program.

 Our Chennai, Hyderabad and Bangalore offices are onsite, 5 days per week. We believe that in\-person interaction and collaboration fosters creativity, and a sense of community, and is critical to our future success as a company.
   

  

 ValGenesis is an equal\-opportunity employer that makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. Our goal is to have the best\-qualified people in every job. title: TC - CS - CTM - AppSec - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**CTM Senior Manager – Application Security**
**Overview**
 As part of our Cyber Security team, you will help secure applications and platforms while ensuring seamless development, build, and deployment capabilities. You will be responsible for designing secure software by identifying security use cases during the design and development stages, including emerging risks from AI/ML\-enabled applications. You will work closely with DevOps, architects, developers, and QA teams to build highly reliable and secure products. You will also coach development teams on building a strong security culture and provide recommendations on vulnerabilities, secure development practices, and the responsible adoption of AI\-driven technologies.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for a Senior Manager – Application Security \& DevSecOps to lead high\-impact application security engagements for enterprise clients. You will drive delivery, mentor teams, expand client relationships, and shape practice offerings across Secure SDLC, DevSecOps, Cloud Security, Threat Modeling, and AI/ML security.
   

  

 This role involves enabling organizations to securely adopt GenAI and AI\-driven solutions, ensuring risks are effectively managed while supporting innovation. This is a client\-facing leadership role requiring both strong technical depth and executive\-level communication.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Client Delivery \& Leadership**
* Lead end\-to\-end application security assessments (SAST/DAST/SCA, penetration testing, secure code review, threat modeling).
* Design and implement Secure SDLC frameworks for Agile/DevOps environments.
* Advise CISOs and CTOs on application security strategy, roadmaps, and ROI.
* Manage large multi\-workstream engagements.
* Advise clients on secure adoption of AI/ML and GenAI solutions, including risk assessments, governance, and secure enterprise integration.
* Lead client\-facing engagements to assess and secure AI/ML applications, providing strategic direction on risk management, governance, and mitigation of vulnerabilities such as prompt injection and data exposure.


**Practice Development**
* Develop proprietary methodologies, accelerators, and IP in AppSec (e.g., AI\-driven secure coding, intelligent vulnerability prioritization, zero\-trust application architecture).
* Contribute to thought leadership — whitepapers, webinars, conference talks (Black Hat, RSA, OWASP).
* Support proposal development and deal closure for strategic pursuits.
* Build and enhance AI security offerings, including GenAI security frameworks and AI risk governance models.


**People \& Team Leadership**
* Mentor and performance\-manage a team of 20–25 consultants (Managers, Seniors, Analysts).
* Build high\-performing, diverse teams with a focus on technical excellence and client empathy.
* Drive utilization, training, and career development.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Experience building enterprise\-scale AppSec and DevSecOps programs from the ground up.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI technologies and their application in enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of AI/ML security risks (model poisoning, prompt injection, data leakage, adversarial attacks) and mitigation techniques.
* Familiarity with secure AI adoption practices, including governance, model lifecycle security, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience contributing to thought leadership, research, or open\-source initiatives in application security.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks (PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, NIST SSDF).
* Executive presence — ability to influence CxOs and translate complex technical risks into business outcomes.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* BE / B.Tech / MCA.
* Minimum of 12\+ years of experience in application security, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, or security architecture.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Prior experience in a Big 4 or similar consulting environment as a Manager / Senior Manager.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AIA - AI Archictect- Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI Architect**
**Enterprise GenAI, Agentic AI and AI Platform Architecture**
**Career Family AIA \- AI / GenAI / Agentic AI**
**Role Type Full Time**
**The opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced AI Architect to lead the design and delivery of secure, scalable and production\-ready enterprise AI solutions. The role combines hands\-on architecture with consulting leadership across Generative AI, Agentic AI, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), AI/ML, cloud platforms and modern application engineering. The architect will translate business priorities into target\-state architectures, reusable patterns and implementation roadmaps while guiding multidisciplinary teams from discovery through deployment and operationalization.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has delivered enterprise or client\-facing AI solutions in pre\-production or production environments and can explain the use case, architecture, personal contribution, controls, delivery approach and outcomes. Certifications, personal projects and demonstrations alone are not sufficient.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead discovery and architecture workshops, clarify business outcomes and non\-functional requirements, and convert them into scalable AI solution designs and delivery roadmaps.
* Architect LLM applications, copilots, RAG and Graph RAG solutions, autonomous agents, multi\-agent workflows, tool/function calling, memory patterns and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* Define reference architectures and reusable patterns for document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, grounding, prompt workflows, model routing and enterprise integrations.
* Select fit\-for\-purpose models, cloud services, vector stores, orchestration frameworks and evaluation approaches based on security, quality, latency, cost, scalability and maintainability requirements.
* Design API\-first, event\-driven and microservices\-based integrations with enterprise applications, data platforms, workflow systems and user experience layers.
* Establish AI evaluation and observability covering retrieval quality, groundedness, accuracy, hallucination risk, agent trajectories, tool execution, latency, cost and user experience.
* Embed Responsible AI, privacy, security and compliance controls including PII protection, access control, auditability, prompt\-injection mitigation, content safety, secure tool execution and data\-leakage prevention.
* Define cloud\-native deployment and operations patterns using containers, Kubernetes or managed services, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, model/LLM operations, monitoring and release controls.
* Lead architecture reviews, technical design reviews, code reviews and production\-readiness assessments; troubleshoot complex issues and guide performance optimization.
* Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, data scientists, engineers, UX teams, security and platform teams to ensure alignment from design through adoption.
* Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, estimates, executive presentations, accelerators, reusable assets and AI practice development.
* Lead and mentor architects and engineers, promote engineering standards, and build capability through coaching and knowledge sharing.


**Skills And Attributes**
**Professional experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in AI, data, analytics, software engineering or digital transformation, including significant responsibility for solution architecture and end\-to\-end delivery.
* Strong hands\-on experience designing and deploying enterprise\-scale AI/ML, GenAI, RAG or Agentic AI solutions in client\-facing environments.
* Proven experience leading cross\-functional teams, architecture governance, stakeholder engagement and complex delivery programs.
* Ability to communicate architecture decisions, trade\-offs and business value to technical and executive audiences.


**Technical Skills**
* Deep understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, Graph RAG, Agentic RAG, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, knowledge graphs, model evaluation and fine\-tuning approaches.
* Hands\-on experience with agent frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI or Google Agent SDK, and familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Strong experience with at least one enterprise cloud AI ecosystem: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI; AWS Bedrock; or GCP Vertex AI and Gemini. Multi\-cloud exposure is preferred.
* Experience with data and AI platforms such as Databricks, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, BigQuery or equivalent enterprise data services.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL; working knowledge of REST APIs, FastAPI, JSON, asynchronous processing, microservices and event\-driven architecture.
* Experience with vector databases, enterprise search, relational and NoSQL data stores, caching and analytics stores.
* Understanding of ML, deep learning, NLP, predictive analytics and the end\-to\-end AI lifecycle.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, MLOps, LLMOps, observability and production support.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture, data governance, model risk, Responsible AI, privacy, cybersecurity, accessibility and regulatory controls.


**Consulting And Leadership Skills**
* Strong client engagement, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, presentation and executive communication skills.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into practical, high\-quality technical architectures and phased implementation plans.
* Leadership in solution estimation, delivery governance, risk management, quality assurance, mentoring and capability building.
* Curiosity, structured problem\-solving, commercial awareness and commitment to continuous learning.


**Education And Preferred Certifications**
* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative discipline.
* Relevant certifications in Azure AI, AWS, Google Cloud, Databricks, AI/ML, Generative AI or enterprise architecture are preferred.


**Why join us**
* Be at the forefront of AI\-driven innovation across multiple client sectors.
* Work with global clients to deliver measurable business impact.
* Collaborate with AI experts, analytics leaders and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations \- Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK \- and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We provide the tools and flexibility so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We provide insights, coaching and confidence to help you become the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be empowered to use your voice and help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: S&C GN - Tech Strategy & Transformation - Tech M&A - Manager
description:
Manager – Technology M\&A Advisory
   

  

 Join our team in Technology Strategy \& Transformation for an exciting opportunity to help leading global organizations navigate the technology dimensions of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve\-outs, and joint ventures.
   

  

 Practice: Technology Strategy \& Transformation, Global Network \| Area of Work: Technology M\&A \| Level: Manager \| Location: Bangalore/Gurgaon/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Hyderabad/Kolkata \| Years of Experience: 8–15 years
   

  

**Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture**
 Do you enjoy solving complex business and technology challenges? Are you passionate about helping clients create value through successful integrations and separations? Do you thrive in fast\-paced transaction environments and enjoy working with senior executives to drive critical business outcomes?
   

  

 Then this is the right place for you.
   

  

**The Practice – A Brief Sketch**
 The Technology M\&A team helps clients navigate the technology implications of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve\-outs, joint ventures, and business transformations. We work across the transaction lifecycle, with a strong focus on post\-deal signing activities including sign\-to\-close planning, Day 1 readiness, integration planning, separation planning, TSA strategy and exit planning, and execution through Integration Management Offices (IMO) and Separation Management Offices (SMO).
   

  

 Our professionals help clients identify and realize transaction value while managing technology risks, operational dependencies, and transformation opportunities. We work closely with executive leadership, business stakeholders, and technology teams to design and execute integration and separation strategies that enable successful transaction outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead technology workstreams across mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve\-outs, and separation engagements.
* Support clients through sign\-to\-close planning activities, identifying technology risks, dependencies, synergies, and execution requirements.
* Develop Day 1 readiness strategies and support Day 1 execution planning.
* Drive technology integration and separation planning across applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, cybersecurity, data, and operating models.
* Support Integration Management Office (IMO) and Separation Management Office (SMO) governance, planning, execution tracking, and stakeholder management.
* Develop TSA strategies, transition plans, service schedules, and TSA exit roadmaps.
* Assess technology costs, risks, synergies, and implementation dependencies associated with transactions.
* Facilitate decision\-making with senior client stakeholders and executive leadership teams.
* Lead teams in delivering technology M\&A programs and manage project financials, staffing, and delivery quality.
* Develop executive\-level presentations, steering committee materials, business cases, and transaction\-related recommendations.


**Bring Your Best Skills Forward**
* Strong experience across Technology M\&A engagements including integration planning, IT Synergy assessments, separation planning, carve\-outs, Day 1 readiness, TSA management, and post\-merger integration activities.
* Ability to connect transaction objectives with technology execution plans and value realization opportunities.
* Experience managing technology workstreams within complex transaction environments and coordinating across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to structure ambiguous problems and develop practical, actionable recommendations.
* Experience leading teams and managing multiple workstreams simultaneously.


**Technology Domain Experience**
 Candidates should possess practical experience in at least one of the following technology domains and understand how these capabilities evolve during M\&A transactions, integrations, and separations:
   

  

* IT Infrastructure \& Cloud
* Infrastructure integration and separation planning.
* Cloud migration and cloud operating model considerations.
* Data center, network, workplace, hosting, and end\-user computing environments.
* Infrastructure TSA planning and exit execution.
* ERP
* Experience with SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar ERP platforms.
* ERP integration, harmonization, migration, or carve\-out activities.
* Understanding of business process impacts, reporting, controls, and data migration considerations during transactions.
* Enterprise Architecture \& IT Operating Model Transformation
* Enterprise architecture assessments and target\-state design.
* Application portfolio rationalization and technology roadmap development.
* IT operating model design and transformation.
* Technology governance, capability models, and organizational design considerations during integrations and separations.


 Deep SME\-level technical expertise is not required; however, candidates should possess sufficient hands\-on experience to assess transaction impacts, identify dependencies and risks, and support planning and execution activities within their chosen technology domain.
   

  

**What’s in it for You?**
* Opportunity to work on high\-profile global M\&A transactions and transformative business programs.
* Exposure to senior client executives and strategic decision\-making processes.
* Collaboration with leading practitioners across Technology Strategy, M\&A, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Cybersecurity, and Industry groups.
* Personalized training and development programs to strengthen transaction, consulting, and leadership capabilities.
* A diverse and inclusive culture focused on innovation, growth, and continuous learning.


**About Accenture:**
 Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions — underpinned by the world’s largest delivery network — Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 569,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**About Accenture Strategy \& Consulting:**
 Accenture Strategy shapes our clients’ future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers and communities. This is our unique differentiator. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy's services include those provided by our Capability Network – a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Our Capability Network teams complement our in\-country teams to deliver cutting\-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. For more information visit https://www.accenture.com/us\-en/Careers/capability\-network

**JOB TITLE:** 
**IT Lead \- Infrastructure**
**Role Purpose**
 The Infrastructure Lead is accountable for the successful design, delivery and transition of the Petrofac Emirates infrastructure, network and IT operations landscape as part of the Emirates Carve\-Out Programme.
   

  

 The role will provide leadership across the infrastructure workstream, ensuring that all solutions are aligned with the approved Emirates architecture, High Level Design (HLD), security standards and programme guiding principles. The individual will work closely with business, technical, security, application, procurement and managed service partners to ensure the infrastructure platform is delivered within agreed timelines, supports Day 1 operational readiness and enables a successful TSA exit.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
**Infrastructure Strategy \& Architecture**
* Own the infrastructure workstream across network, cloud, operational tooling and managed services for the new Petrofac Emirates.
* Ensure all infrastructure decisions align with the approved Emirates HLD, target architecture and programme guiding principles.
* Act as the primary infrastructure technical authority within the programme, reviewing designs and challenging deviations from architecture standards.
* Ensure infrastructure solutions remain scalable, secure, supportable and aligned to the future Petrofac Emirates operating model.
* Support design governance and architecture review forums.


**Delivery \& Implementation**
* Lead the delivery of the Emirates infrastructure platform, including cloud infrastructure, networking, connectivity, identity dependencies, monitoring, backup, recovery and operational tooling.
* Ensure all infrastructure activities are delivered in accordance with programme plans, milestones and TSA exit timelines.
* Coordinate internal teams, vendors and managed service providers to achieve successful implementation outcomes.
* Oversee infrastructure testing, service validation, operational readiness and transition into support.
* Proactively identify risks, issues and dependencies that may impact programme delivery.


**Cross\-Workstream Integration**
* Act as the primary infrastructure representative across all Emirates programme workstreams.
* Collaborate closely with Application, ERP, Security, Identity, Data, Procurement and Business Readiness leads to ensure all technical dependencies are understood, managed and delivered.
* Ensure infrastructure services are provisioned in line with application migration schedules and business cutover plans.
* Support integrated planning, sequencing and dependency management across the wider programme.


**Operational Stability \& Risk Management**
* Ensure carve\-out activities do not negatively impact existing Petrofac operational services, users or critical business processes.
* Challenge delivery approaches that introduce unnecessary transition risk or future operational cost burdens.
* Ensure robust operational readiness, support processes and service management controls are established prior to go\-live.
* Ensure robust compliance with Information and Cybersecurity standards and directives


**Commercial \& Vendor Management**
* Work closely with Procurement and Commercial teams to support infrastructure\-related vendor selection, contracting and mobilisation activities.
* Manage infrastructure delivery partners and suppliers against agreed scope, timelines and quality expectations.
* Review technical proposals and commercial options to ensure alignment with programme objectives and architecture standards.
* Monitor vendor performance, deliverables and issue resolution throughout the lifecycle of the programme.


**Governance \& Reporting**
* Input to RAID Logs and status updates to the Programme Director and Steering Committee.
* Escalate key risks, decisions and dependencies in a timely manner.
* Support executive reporting and governance forums as required.


**Experience \& Qualifications**
* 10\+ years' experience leading enterprise infrastructure, network or cloud transformation programmes.
* Proven experience delivering complex infrastructure initiatives.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, IT operations, service management and managed service operating models.
* Experience managing system integrators, outsourcing providers and technology partners.
* Strong stakeholder management skills across technical, business and executive audiences.
* Demonstrated experience managing delivery across multiple interdependent workstreams.
* Experience within engineering, construction, EPC, energy or industrial sectors.
* Desirable
* Formal programme or project management qualifications (PMP, PRINCE2, MSP or equivalent).
* Critical Success Measures
* Infrastructure delivery achieved in line with programme milestones and TSA exit dates.
* Full compliance with Emirates HLD and architecture standards.
* Successful Day 1 operational readiness and business continuity.
* No material disruption to RemainingCo services or operations.
* Effective management of cross\-workstream dependencies.
* Infrastructure platform transitioned successfully into steady\-state operations.

description:
PROJECT ENGINEER – COMMERCIAL INTERIORS
 



 Industry: Commercial Interiors \| Glass \& Aluminium Works
 



 Department: Projects
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time \| On\-Site
 



 Experience: 3–6 Years
 



 Locations: Chennai \& Mumbai
 



 Openings: 1 – Chennai \| 1 – Mumbai
 



 Salary: ₹5–6 LPA – Chennai \| ₹6–7 LPA – Mumbai
 



 Travel: PAN India project travel as required
 



 JOB SUMMARY
 



 We are looking for a hands\-on Project Engineer with 3–6 years of relevant experience in commercial interior projects, with strong exposure to glass partitions, aluminium works, interior fit\-outs, and on\-site project execution.
 



 The candidate will be responsible for day\-to\-day site execution, manpower and subcontractor coordination, project progress and quality monitoring, material and drawing coordination, and communication with clients, consultants, vendors, and other project stakeholders.
 



 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



 Project Execution \& Coordination
 


* Plan and supervise daily site execution as per approved drawings, specifications, and project schedules.
* Coordinate with project managers, design teams, subcontractors, vendors, clients, and consultants.
* Monitor manpower, productivity, work fronts, and project progress.
* Identify site constraints and coordinate timely resolution.
* Participate in site meetings and provide progress updates.



 Technical \& Drawing Coordination
 


* Read and interpret architectural and shop drawings.
* Coordinate drawing clarifications and raise RFIs/technical queries.
* Verify site dimensions, levels, alignment, plumb, and finishing.
* Identify discrepancies between drawings and actual site conditions.
* Coordinate material requirements based on drawings and site progress.



 Glass \& Aluminium Works
 


* Supervise installation of single and double\-glazed glass partitions.
* Manage aluminium\-framed partitions and related systems.
* Supervise glass and DG doors, solid and honeycomb shutters, stile doors, and related systems.
* Ensure proper installation of glass, aluminium profiles, hardware, joints, sealants, and finishing.



 Manpower \& Subcontractor Management
 


* Plan and allocate manpower according to project priorities.
* Supervise site supervisors, installers, workers, and subcontractors.
* Monitor workmanship, productivity, and work quality.
* Coordinate subcontractors to ensure timely project completion.



 Material, Quality \& Safety
 


* Prepare material requirements based on drawings and site progress.
* Coordinate with procurement and stores teams for material availability.
* Check incoming materials against approved specifications and samples.
* Monitor material usage, wastage, storage, and handling.
* Conduct regular site quality inspections.
* Track and close NCRs, observations, and punch points.
* Ensure compliance with site HSE requirements and proper PPE usage.
* Ensure safe handling, movement, and installation of glass.



 Planning, Reporting \& Billing
 


* Prepare daily and weekly work plans and Daily Progress Reports (DPR).
* Track progress against project schedules.
* Maintain manpower, material, measurement, and productivity records.
* Maintain RFIs, inspection requests, drawing registers, NCR records, site photographs, and handover documentation.
* Take accurate site measurements and verify executed quantities.
* Support RA bills and subcontractor billing.
* Track variations and additional works.



 REQUIRED QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE
 


* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 3–6 years of relevant experience in commercial interiors, interior fit\-out, glass partition, aluminium works, façade, or commercial construction.
* Commercial interiors experience is mandatory.
* Project coordination experience is mandatory.
* Strong hands\-on on\-site project execution experience.
* Experience coordinating manpower, subcontractors, materials, drawings, and site activities.
* Experience in glass partition and aluminium works is strongly preferred.
* Willingness to work on\-site and travel across India as required.



 REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS
 


* Commercial interior fit\-out
* Glass partition systems
* Single and double glazing
* Toughened and laminated glass
* Aluminium profiles and framing
* Glass and DG doors
* Door hardware and accessories
* Silicone and sealant applications
* Basic AutoCAD drawing reading
* Site measurement and quantity calculation
* Project planning and site execution
* Quality inspection and basic site safety



 IDEAL CANDIDATE
 



 A technically sound and proactive Project Engineer who can independently handle commercial interior site execution and project coordination, while effectively managing drawings, manpower, subcontractors, materials, quality, progress, measurements, and stakeholder communication.
 



 LOCATION: Chennai \& Mumbai

 SALARY: ₹5–6 LPA – Chennai \| ₹6–7 LPA – Mumbai

title: Project Planner
description:
**Shape the Future of Global Industrial Projects as a Project Planner, PMO**
 Are you ready for the next step in your career? Join us as a Project Planner, PMO and play a key role in supporting complex industrial projects across the Asia Pacific region. Based in Chennai, you will work closely with project managers, site teams, subcontractors, and stakeholders to ensure projects stay on track from engineering and procurement through construction and commissioning.
   

  

 You will be at the center of project execution, transforming schedules into actionable plans, identifying risks early, and helping teams deliver successful outcomes. This is an opportunity to build expertise in global project management while contributing directly to business performance through effective planning and progress control.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* You will develop, maintain, and optimize project schedules in Safran Project or MS Project using standardized PEC templates and Valmet WBS structures.
* You will produce and manage baseline schedules, resource plans, manpower histograms, S\-curves, Earned Value reporting, and progress forecasts to provide clear project visibility.
* You will facilitate planning workshops and collaborate with project teams, discipline leads, site teams, subcontractors, and project managers to gather schedule inputs and align project objectives.
* You will monitor project progress, analyze critical paths, detect delays early, and prepare recovery or mitigation plans to keep projects on track.
* You will support project reviews, change management, claim management, risk and opportunity processes, and sales\-phase scheduling activities while communicating schedule status to internal and customer stakeholders.


**Expectations for you**
* You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in project planning, scheduling, or project controls within industrial EPC or capital investment projects. Experience across both Engineering \& Procurement and Construction \& Commissioning phases is an advantage.
* You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or another relevant technical field.
* You have hands\-on experience with professional CPM scheduling tools. Experience with Safran Project is a strong advantage, and strong Excel skills are required. Knowledge of Power BI is beneficial.
* You have customer\-facing experience and strong communication skills for leading workshops, project reviews, and stakeholder discussions.
* You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
* Some travel is included in this role, although travel requirements are expected to be limited.


**To succeed in this role**
 Success in this role requires strong expertise in project scheduling, progress monitoring, and schedule analysis within complex industrial projects. You combine a solid understanding of the full project lifecycle with the ability to work accurately at a detailed activity level. You are able to manage multiple priorities independently, communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders, and proactively identify risks and opportunities that support successful project delivery.
   

  

 We Also Expect You To Align With Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical Behaviors That Guide How We Lead, Collaborate, And Succeed Together
   

  

* Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through
* Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly
* Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety
* Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value


**We offer**
 You will join a team of experienced planners located across Tampere, Gothenburg, Sundsvall, Copenhagen, Ulvila, and Chennai, supporting PEC projects globally. The team works closely with project organizations to develop robust schedules, monitor project performance, and improve planning practices across the business. You will gain valuable exposure to international projects and collaborate with experienced professionals across multiple regions and disciplines. Your work will have a direct impact on project success by ensuring schedules are accurate, progress is transparent, and corrective actions are taken when needed. This role offers excellent visibility into industrial project management and the opportunity to influence project outcomes on a global scale.
   

  

 At Valmet, you'll find an international and collaborative working environment where continuous learning and professional growth are encouraged. We provide modern tools, global project exposure, and opportunities to develop your expertise while contributing to sustainable industrial solutions.
   

  

 Want to know more? Did we catch your interest? We'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**Please submit your application and CV by October 5, 2026\.**
 We may begin interviews before the application deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that applications submitted via email cannot be accepted.
   

  

**When everything works together**
 Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting\-edge technologies and services as well as mission\-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.
   

  

 At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views.
   

  

 Join the team – and lead the way with us! www.valmet.com/careers

title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS\-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high\-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market\-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high\-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS\-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost\-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading\-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all\-wafer\-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS\-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**

* Strategic Leadership: Define and drive the long\-term vision and roadmap for distributed IMC software infrastructure supporting image computing clusters.

* Platform Architecture: Oversee the design and implementation of scalable, fault\-tolerant distributed systems optimized for hybrid CPU/GPU workloads.
* Lifecycle Management: Lead the end\-to\-end development of image computing platforms, from requirements gathering through deployment and maintenance, using best\-in\-class project management practices.
* Developer Enablement: Deliver robust software platforms and tools that empower engineers to develop, test, and deploy new image processing and deep learning algorithms efficiently.
* Innovation in Hybrid Computing: Spearhead the integration of traditional image processing and AI/DL techniques into a unified hybrid computing architecture, leveraging modern HPC technologies.


**Qualifications:**
* Education:
+ Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

* Experience:
+ 10\+ years of experience in software engineering
+ Proven track record in building and scaling distributed systems, preferably in HPC or cloud\-native environments.
+ Experience with image processing, computer vision, or AI/ML infrastructure is highly desirable.

* Technical Skills:
+ Deep Understanding of distributed computing frameworks \& Linux Systems Programming
+ Proficiency in C\+\+, Python, and/or other systems programming languages.
+ Working knowledge of container technologies, orchestration frameworks (e.g., Kubernetes), and workflow automation.
+ Familiarity with GPU computing and hybrid CPU/GPU architectures.
+ Strong grasp of software development best practices, CI/CD, and DevOps principles.

* Leadership \& Communication:
+ Demonstrated ability to lead and drive functional teams.
+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
+ Passion for mentoring and developing engineering talent.


**Minimum Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field

description:
**WorkNEXT AI Transformation Head**
**Role Summary**
 The WorkNEXT AI Tech Expert is the technical ambassador for WorkNEXT AI modules—owning end\-to\-end client engagement, discovery, solution design, demos, pilots, and technical enablement. This role translates business pain points into pragmatic AI solutions, drives adoption and outcomes, and partners with product, engineering, and customer success to ensure WorkNEXT deployments deliver measurable value at scale.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Client Engagement \& Solutioning**

* Design proof\-of\-concepts (POCs) and pilot plans, including success criteria, data readiness, and deployment approach.
* Translate business needs into AI\-driven use cases and solution designs (incl. integrations, data pipelines, governance).


**Technical Ownership**
* Build reference architectures and implementation playbooks for WorkNEXT AI modules across common enterprise stacks.
* Partner with engineering to scope features, validate feasibility, and drive technical issue resolution.
* Configure and optimize WorkNEXT AI models and workflows (prompt strategies, orchestration, guardrails, evaluation).
* Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and responsible AI standards; coordinate with InfoSec and legal teams.


**Customer Success \& Enablement**
* Create client\-facing technical collateral: solution briefs, runbooks, FAQs, architecture diagrams, ROI calculators.
* Train client admins and super\-users; develop enablement plans and adoption campaigns.
* Monitor post\-deployment health: performance metrics, drift, model evaluation, user feedback loops.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Capture client feedback and market signals to inform product roadmap and prioritization.
* Collaborate with Sales/Pre\-Sales for deal strategy, estimates, and RFP responses.
* Work with Data Engineering and Integration teams to ensure robust pipelines and API/connector reliability.


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
**Technical**
* Strong understanding of AI/ML foundations: NLP, LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, model evaluation.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks).
* Knowledge of data pipelines (ETL/ELT), vector databases/embeddings, and observability of AI systems.
* Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and responsible AI (RBAC, PII handling, auditability, human\-in\-the\-loop).
* Ability to create architecture diagrams, deployment runbooks, and performance monitoring strategies.


**Client\-Facing**
* Exceptional communication—can simplify complex AI concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Consultative approach—discovery, problem framing, value story, and objection handling.
* Strong demo presence; comfortable tailoring demos to industry verticals and role personas.
* Negotiation and stakeholder management across business, IT, InfoSec, and procurement.


**Mindset**
* Outcome\-oriented: focuses on measurable business impact, not just features.
* Curious and experimental: rapid prototyping, A/B testing, iterative improvement.
* Ownership and accountability: proactive risk management, transparent communication.


**Qualifications**
* 6–10\+ years in Client\-Facing Technical roles (e.g., Solutions Architect, Pre\-Sales Engineer, AI Consultant).
* 3\+ years hands\-on with AI/ML, LLM applications, or automation platforms.
* Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in at least one enterprise vertical (e.g., BFSI, Manufacturing, Retail, Healthcare) is a plus.
* Certifications in cloud/AI (Azure AI Engineer, AWS ML Specialty, GCP ML Engineer) preferred.


**Typical WorkNEXT AI Use\-Case Areas (Adjust to your modules)**
* Knowledge assistant with RAG for policy/SOP retrieval, multilingual Q\&A.
* Process automation: ticket triage, claim summarization, email drafting, task routing.
* Insight generation: summarization of meetings/chats, trend analysis, risk alerts.
* Employee experience: HR policy assistant, IT helpdesk copilot, onboarding flows.
* Compliance \& governance: redaction, PII detection, audit\-ready conversation logs.


**Tools \& Tech Stack (Illustrative)**
* Cloud \& Infra: Azure (OpenAI, Cognitive Search), AWS (Bedrock, Sagemaker), GCP (Vertex AI).
* Data: Databricks/Snowflake/BigQuery; ETL tools (ADF, Airflow), vector stores (Pinecone, FAISS).
* Integration: REST/GraphQL APIs, iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi), event buses (Kafka).
* Observability \& Evaluation: Prometheus/Grafana, MLflow, human eval tooling, prompt/version management.
* Security: OAuth2/OIDC, RBAC, KMS, DLP; Responsible AI guardrails \& content filters.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AIA - Mainframe - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced Manager – Mainframe Modernization to lead our AI\-Driven Legacy Transformation practice. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise across mainframe ecosystems, AI/ML\-driven modernization strategies, and cloud technologies, combined with strong leadership, stakeholder management, and team\-building capabilities to deliver large\-scale digital transformation programmes.
   

  

 You will own the end\-to\-end modernization strategy, drive cross\-functional collaboration with C\-suite leaders, business stakeholders, and architecture teams, and lead a team of engineers and specialists to successfully migrate mission\-critical mainframe workloads to modern, scalable, cloud\-native platforms using AI\-powered automation frameworks.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence:**
* Strategic Leadership and Stakeholder Management
+ Define and own the mainframe modernization strategy aligned with business objectives and enterprise technology roadmaps.
+ Collaborate with senior stakeholders, business leaders, and architecture teams to prioritise modernization initiatives and secure executive buy\-in.
+ Evaluate and recommend modernization paths — rehosting, refactoring, rebuilding, or replacing — based on cost\-benefit analysis, risk assessment, and business impact.

* Mainframe Systems Assessment and Governance
+ Oversee comprehensive assessments of mainframe applications (COBOL, JCL, VSAM, DB2, CICS, IMS, Assembler) to identify modernization opportunities, risks, and dependencies.
+ Establish governance frameworks, quality gates, and standards for modernization delivery across the portfolio.
+ Drive technical debt identification, quantification, and systematic reduction across the legacy estate.

* AI\-Driven Modernization and Automation
+ Champion the adoption of AI tools, LLMs, and custom AI agentic workflows for automated code analysis, refactoring, and code translation at scale.
+ Define and operationalise AI pipelines, prompt engineering standards, and context engineering best practices to maximise modernization throughput and accuracy.
+ Evaluate emerging AI/ML technologies and integrate them into the modernization toolchain to maintain competitive advantage.

* Team Leadership and Capability Building
+ Lead, mentor, and grow a team of mainframe modernization engineers, developers, and analysts.
+ Build team capabilities in AI\-driven modernization, cloud\-native development, and DevOps practices.
+ Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and provide technical guidance to ensure delivery excellence.

* Target\-State Architecture – APIs and Microservices
+ Architect and oversee the design of target\-state systems, including API integrations, microservices, and event\-driven architectures.
+ Ensure modernized solutions are scalable, resilient, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.

* Cloud and Platform Integration
+ Lead the migration of mainframe workloads to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) using AI\-driven and automated solutions.
+ Ensure seamless integration of legacy systems with cloud\-native services, containerised deployments (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
+ Drive adoption of infrastructure\-as\-code, observability, and security best practices for modernized workloads.

* Reporting, Documentation, and Business Impact
+ Create and present executive\-level reporting on modernization progress, business impact, risks, and ROI.
+ Maintain comprehensive technical documentation including system designs, AI pipeline architectures, and modernization roadmaps.
+ Track and communicate KPIs related to migration velocity, quality, cost savings, and operational efficiency.


**Skills and Attributes:**
* Educational Background
* Bachelor / master’s degree in computer science, AI, Any Engineering or quantitative background preferred.


**Professional Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience with legacy mainframe systems (COBOL, JCL, Assembler, CICS, DB2, IMS, VSAM) with at least 3–4 years in a leadership or managerial capacity.
* Proven track record of leading large\-scale mainframe modernization or digital transformation programmes.
* Deep expertise in data migration, integration, ETL, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
* Strong proficiency in programming/scripting languages (Python, Java, etc.).
* Expert\-level knowledge of APIs, microservices architecture, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Extensive experience with AI tools, LLM API calls, prompt engineering, and context engineering for automating code analysis and modernization workflows.
* Experience with enterprise modernization platforms (Micro Focus, AWS Mainframe Modernization, Azure Migrate, Google Cloud Dual Run) is a plus.
* Hands\-on experience building or managing AI/ML pipelines for code transformation at scale.


**Soft Skills**
* Exceptional client engagement and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into practical, high\-quality technical solutions.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership abilities.
* Experience with Agile/SAFe delivery methodologies and managing distributed/global teams.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Cloud certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP), AI/ML certifications, enterprise architecture (TOGAF), or mainframe\-related certifications are a plus.


**Why Join Us**
* Be at the forefront of AI\-driven mainframe modernization across enterprise clients.
* Work with global clients to drive real business impact through large\-scale digital transformation.
* Collaborate with a team of modernization experts, AI specialists, and industry leaders in a highly innovative and entrepreneurial environment.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, serving our clients locally and globally with innovation and at scale.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Technical Project Manager Microsoft
description:
Technical Project Manager – Microsoft Power Platform \& Enterprise Applications
 



 Company: Techworkstalent Pvt. Ltd.
 



 Location: Chennai / India
 



 Work Mode: Full\-time
 



 Experience: 7–12 Years
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



 About Techworkstalent
 



 Techworkstalent is an technology solutions company delivering enterprise application development, automation, CRM, low\-code/no\-code and digital transformation solutions to customers across India and international markets.
 



 We are expanding our enterprise technology delivery practice and are looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager who can lead complex application development and digital transformation projects involving Microsoft Power Platform, enterprise integrations, AI/Copilot, CRM, workflow automation and low\-code platforms.
 



 Role Overview
 



 The Technical Project Manager will be responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of technology projects, from requirement discovery and solution planning through development, testing, deployment and post\-production support.
 



 The role requires a combination of:
 


* Strong project management
* Technical understanding
* Client/stakeholder management
* Agile delivery
* Team leadership
* Risk and dependency management
* Commercial and scope control



 The ideal candidate should be technically strong enough to understand architecture discussions, review estimates and challenge technical assumptions, while being commercially and operationally strong enough to own the overall delivery.
 



  





  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. End\-to\-End Project Ownership
 


* Own the project from kick\-off to successful production deployment.
* Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones and timelines.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans.
* Establish project governance and reporting mechanisms.
* Track project progress against agreed timelines, scope and budget.
* Ensure all project deliverables are completed on time and to agreed quality standards.
* Manage multiple projects/workstreams simultaneously when required.



  





 2\. Technical Project Management
 



 Work closely with Solution Architects, Developers, Business Analysts, QA Engineers and Integration Specialists to ensure technical delivery is aligned with the approved solution.
 



 The PM should be able to understand and coordinate projects involving:
 


* Microsoft Power Apps
* Microsoft Dataverse
* Power Automate
* Copilot Studio / AI Agents
* REST API integrations
* SQL / relational databases
* SharePoint
* Microsoft 365
* CRM platforms
* Workflow automation
* Low\-code/no\-code platforms
* Cloud applications
* Third\-party enterprise applications



 You are not expected to be the primary developer, but you should be technically strong enough to understand what is being built, how it is being built, the dependencies involved and whether the proposed timeline is realistic.
 



  





 3\. Requirement \& Scope Management
 


* Work with clients and Business Analysts to understand business requirements.
* Participate in requirement workshops and solution discussions.
* Convert business requirements into actionable technical workstreams.
* Ensure requirements are documented and approved.
* Identify gaps, ambiguities and dependencies early.
* Control scope throughout the project lifecycle.
* Manage Change Requests and assess their impact on:
* Cost
* Timeline
* Resources
* Architecture
* Delivery risk



  





 4\. Project Planning \& Estimation
 


* Work with technical leads to prepare project estimates.
* Validate effort estimates and delivery assumptions.
* Build project schedules and resource plans.
* Identify critical\-path activities.
* Define development, integration, testing and deployment milestones.
* Track actual effort against estimated effort.
* Highlight potential overruns early and recommend corrective action.



  





 5\. Team Management
 



 Lead cross\-functional technology teams consisting of:
 


* Solution Architects
* Power Platform Developers
* Software Developers
* Integration Developers
* AI/Copilot Developers
* Business Analysts
* QA Engineers
* UI/UX resources
* DevOps / Cloud engineers



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Assigning tasks and ownership.
* Monitoring individual and team productivity.
* Removing delivery blockers.
* Conducting project reviews.
* Ensuring clear accountability.
* Managing resource utilization.
* Escalating performance or capability issues when required.



  





 6\. Agile Delivery
 


* Conduct Agile ceremonies including:
* Sprint Planning
* Daily Stand\-ups
* Sprint Reviews
* Retrospectives
* Backlog Refinement
* Maintain product/project backlog.
* Track sprint commitments and velocity.
* Ensure stories have clear acceptance criteria.
* Monitor sprint progress and impediments.
* Coordinate releases across development, QA and production environments.



 Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday.com or similar project management tools is preferred.
 



  





 7\. Client \& Stakeholder Management
 



 Act as the primary delivery interface between Techworkstalent and the client.
 


* Conduct regular project status meetings.
* Present project progress, risks and dependencies.
* Manage client expectations.
* Communicate delays and corrective actions proactively.
* Handle escalations professionally.
* Coordinate requirement clarifications with client stakeholders.
* Obtain approvals/sign\-offs at appropriate project milestones.
* Build strong relationships with client technology and business teams.



 The candidate must be comfortable interacting with CXO\-level stakeholders, IT heads, business leaders and enterprise technology teams.
 



  





 8\. Risk \& Dependency Management
 


* Maintain project RAID logs.
* Identify risks before they become delivery issues.
* Track:
* Risks
* Assumptions
* Issues
* Dependencies
* Decisions
* Develop mitigation and contingency plans.
* Escalate critical risks to leadership in a timely manner.
* Monitor cross\-team and third\-party dependencies.



  





 9\. Quality \& Delivery Governance
 


* Ensure development follows agreed technical and coding standards.
* Coordinate with QA to establish testing plans.
* Track SIT, UAT and production readiness.
* Ensure defects are appropriately prioritized and resolved.
* Coordinate UAT sign\-off.
* Ensure deployment readiness checklists are completed.
* Coordinate production releases and hypercare.
* Conduct project closure and lessons\-learned reviews.



  





 10\. Commercial \& Financial Management
 



 The Technical Project Manager will also have responsibility for protecting project commercials.
 


* Track project effort against approved estimates.
* Monitor resource utilization.
* Identify scope creep.
* Flag potential margin erosion.
* Support Change Request estimation.
* Work with management on billing milestones and deliverables.
* Ensure projects are delivered within approved commercial parameters.



  





  





 Required Technical Skills
 



 Must Have
 


* 7\+ years of experience in software/technology project delivery.
* 3\+ years of experience managing technical projects.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle.
* Experience managing enterprise application development projects.
* Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Strong understanding of APIs and system integrations.
* Understanding of databases and data models.
* Understanding of cloud applications and enterprise architecture.
* Experience managing developers, QA and technical teams.
* Strong client\-facing communication skills.



 Strongly Preferred
 



 Experience with one or more of:
 


* Microsoft Power Platform
* Power Apps
* Dataverse
* Power Automate
* Microsoft Copilot Studio
* Azure
* Microsoft 365
* CRM implementations
* Zoho / Salesforce / Dynamics
* Low\-code/no\-code platforms
* AI/GenAI application projects
* Enterprise API integrations



 The candidate does not need to be an expert developer, but should be technically conversant in these areas.
 



  





  





 Project Management Skills
 


* Agile / Scrum
* Waterfall / Hybrid delivery
* Project planning
* Resource planning
* Estimation
* Risk management
* Change management
* Scope management
* Stakeholder management
* Vendor management
* UAT management
* Release management
* Project reporting
* Budget/effort tracking



 Tools
 



 Experience with:
 


* Jira
* Azure DevOps
* Microsoft Teams
* Confluence
* MS Project
* Monday.com
* Zoho Projects or similar tools



  





  





 Documentation \& Reporting
 



 The candidate should be comfortable preparing and maintaining:
 


* Project plans
* Schedules
* RAID logs
* Status reports
* Sprint reports
* Resource plans
* Requirement trackers
* Risk registers
* Change Requests
* Meeting minutes
* UAT plans
* Deployment checklists
* Project closure reports



  





  





 Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* PMP / PRINCE2 / Scrum Master certification is an advantage.
* Microsoft Power Platform certification is an advantage.
* Relevant technical certifications are preferred.



  





  





 Ideal Candidate Profile
 



 We are looking for someone who is not just a project coordinator.
 



 The ideal candidate should be able to walk into a client meeting, understand the business requirement, participate meaningfully in the technical discussion, question unrealistic estimates, identify delivery risks, coordinate the technical team and communicate the situation clearly to management.
 



 You should be comfortable moving between:
 



 Client → Business Requirement → Solution Architecture → Development → QA → UAT → Production
 



 and ensuring that nothing falls through the gaps.
 



 You should have a strong ownership mindset and be comfortable saying:
 



 "This is the requirement, this is the proposed solution, these are the dependencies, this is the effort, this is the risk, and this is what we need to do to deliver it successfully."
 



  





 Key Success Metrics
 



 Success in this role will be measured by:
 


* On\-time project delivery
* Delivery within approved scope
* Project profitability/margin protection
* Client satisfaction
* Resource utilization
* Reduction in delivery escalations
* Quality of deliverables
* Effective risk management
* Successful UAT and production deployment
* Repeat business / expansion opportunities from existing clients

**Position Summary**
**Windchill PTC – Consultant, Technical Transformation**
**Enterprise Performance**
 Our Enterprise Performance team helps organizations improve business performance by connecting strategy, operations, and technology across product development, supply chain, and enterprise platforms. We work with clients to deliver digital transformation initiatives that improve efficiency, strengthen processes, and support scalable business outcomes.
   

  

 As part of this team, you will support Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and technical transformation efforts with a focus on Windchill and the broader PTC ecosystem. Our professionals help clients modernize product data, enhance engineering and change processes, and integrate PLM solutions with enterprise systems to drive more connected and effective operations.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need\-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.

 As a Consultant, Technical Transformation on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Design, develop, and customize end\-to\-end Windchill product lifecycle management (PLM) solutions across migration, configuration, and integration workstreams
* Configure Windchill components including lifecycles, workflows, change management, business rules, and bill of materials management to support business requirements

* Build and support technical solutions using Java, Java 2 Platform, Enterprise Edition (J2EE), JavaScript, and Extensible Markup Language (XML) within Windchill environments

* Experience with computer\-aided design (CAD) data migration for SolidWorks and AutoCAD
* Experience configuring Windchill 10\.x and 11\.x, including business configuration, change management, workflows, and bill of materials management
* Experience developing or supporting Windchill technical solutions using Java, Java 2 Platform, Enterprise Edition (J2EE), JavaScript, and Extensible Markup Language (XML)
* Experience reviewing or supporting PLM code, integration configurations, install scripts, build scripts, deployment scripts, cron jobs, and custom utilities across development, quality assurance, and production environments
* Experience in automotive, manufacturing, or consumer goods industries

* Experience with multiple product lifecycle management (PLM) frameworks

* Experience aligning PLM enterprise architecture to client roadmaps
