**EY GDS – Data and Analytics (D\&A) – Techno\-Functional Data Consultant – Insurance (Senior Con.)**
 As part of our EY\-GDS D\&A (Data and Analytics) team, we help our clients solve complex business challenges with the help of data and technology. We dive deep into data to extract the greatest value and discover opportunities in key business and functions like Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing and Auto, Supply Chain, and Finance
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking a highly motivated
 **Techno\-Functional Data Consultant** 
 to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams within our insurance data transformation and migration initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess strong data analysis and data modelling capabilities, coupled with a solid understanding of insurance business processes and data structures.
   

  

 This role will be responsible for translating business requirements into data solutions, supporting data migration and integration activities, defining data models, and ensuring data quality across strategic insurance platforms.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Business \& Functional Analysis**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, SMEs, and product owners to understand business processes, data requirements, and reporting needs.
* Elicit, document, and validate functional and data requirements.
* Conduct impact assessments for business and regulatory changes affecting data assets.
* Facilitate workshops and act as a liaison between business and technical teams.


**Data Analysis \& Data Management**
* Perform detailed source\-to\-target data analysis and mapping.
* Analyse complex datasets to identify data quality issues, gaps, inconsistencies, and transformation requirements.
* Support data governance initiatives, including data lineage, data definitions, and business rules documentation.
* Define and validate data migration and reconciliation rules.


**Data Modelling**
* Design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
* Develop entity relationship diagrams (ERDs) and data dictionaries.
* Define data structures, relationships, and business rules to support operational and analytical requirements.
* Ensure alignment between business processes and target data architecture.
* Collaborate with solution architects and development teams to implement data models.
* Work closely with ETL, Data Engineering, and Development teams to ensure requirements are accurately implemented.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
**Data Modelling Skills**
* Demonstrable experience in conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling.
* Proficiency with data modelling tools such as ERwin, ER/Studio, SAP PowerDesigner, Lucidchart, Visio, or similar.
* Strong understanding of relational databases and data architecture principles.
* Experience creating and maintaining enterprise data models and data dictionaries.


**Functional Skills**
* Strong understanding of insurance business processes and data.
* Experience working on policy, customer, claims, underwriting, or broker data domains.
* Proven experience in requirements gathering, business analysis, and stakeholder management.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical and data specifications.


**Data Skills**
* Strong data analysis skills using SQL(mandatory) and related data tools.
* Hands\-on experience in data profiling, data quality assessment, and data mapping.
* Experience in data migration and system transformation projects.
* Understanding of data governance and master data management principles.
* Hands\-on experience with one or more reporting and analytics platforms like Power BI, MicroStrategy (MSTR), Tableau, Qlik Sense/QlikView
* Experience in Dashboard design and development, KPI definition and reporting frameworks, Semantic data models, Self\-service reporting solutions, Executive and operational reporting


**Technical Skills**
* Experience working with relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar.
* Understanding of data warehousing and ETL concepts.
* Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and cloud\-based data platforms


**Good to Have**
* Experience within the UK Insurance market, including General Insurance, London Market Insurance, Syndicate and MGA environments


**Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Data Analysis, Data Consulting, or Data Migration roles.
* Minimum 5\+ years of hands\-on data modelling experience.
* Insurance domain experience preferred.
* UK Insurance market experience highly desirable.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong project management skills
* Client management skills
* Solutioning skills


**What We Look For**
 People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
   

  

**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Project Manager Services
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
   

  

 Could you be the full\-time Project Manager Services in Chennai we’re looking for?
   

  

**Your future role**
 Take on a new challenge and apply your leadership and project management expertise in a cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative and dynamic teammates.
   

  

 You'll play a key role in driving the execution of projects with low criticality, ensuring contractual requirements and customer expectations are met while optimizing financial performance. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (Project Core Team, Customer Director, Support Functions), define project strategies, and lead project activities from transfer to close\-out, and much more.
   

  

 You’ll specifically take care of project governance and stakeholder coordination, but also ensure compliance with applicable standards and proactively manage risks and opportunities.
   

  

 We’ll look to you for:
   

  

* Owning the Project Management Work Package (WP) and being accountable for project Quality, Cost, Delivery, and Planning (QCDP) performance.
* Defining project strategies and aligning objectives with contract requirements.
* Leading and coordinating project activities and stakeholders, including resource management and team leadership.
* Ensuring alignment with customer contractual requirements and managing variation orders.
* Proactively managing risks, savings, and opportunities to optimize project outcomes.
* Representing the project to Alstom management and external stakeholders with transparency and professionalism.


**All About You**
 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
   

  

* Master’s degree or bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
* 5 years of experience as a sub\-system/component manager, qualified project manager, or manager of an operational scope, with a total of at least 15 years of professional experience in Rolling Stock (RS).
* Experience working in and with multinational companies and across diverse business cultures.
* Knowledge of project management processes and railway products and systems.
* Strong skills in team management, communication, and negotiation.
* Leadership, entrepreneurial mindset, and a results\-oriented approach.
* IPMA Level C certification (or equivalent) is desirable.
* Familiarity with Alstom’s way of working for efficient process execution is a plus.


**Things you’ll enjoy** 
 Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
   

  

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long\-term career free from monotonous daily routines.
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling.
* Collaborate with transverse teams and supportive colleagues.
* Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of mobility.
* Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment.
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award\-winning learning programs.
* Progress towards senior leadership roles or other areas of interest.
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).


 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

**Important to note**
 As a global business, we’re an equal\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: Manager II Program Management, Global Catalog Operations
description:
**Description**
 Amazon.com operates in a global eCommerce environment without boundaries, and operates a diverse set of businesses worldwide, including Retail, third party marketplaces, eCommerce platforms, web services for developers.
   

  

 The Amazon product catalog is a set of records; each record being a set of facts describing a physical or digital product. These records are often organized by defined relationships (e.g. variations such as different sizes of the same shoe). Our ability to provide a good product discovery experience and empower our customers to make well informed purchase decisions is dependent on the quality of our product catalog. In a high quality catalog, every product is described with a complete, structured, accurate and correctly normalized set of facts. Every product is represented by a unique record appropriately related to one another.
   

  

 The Global catalog operations (GCO) team is part of Amazon Selection \& Catalog services (ASCS) teams in India focus on leveraging human intelligence, external or internal, to measure and improve the quality of the catalog: Global catalog operations (GCO) charter is to make Catalog engineering programs more effective by providing expert human judgment. Catalog Operations from its inception has been partnering with engineering teams to run programs focused on improving the data quality of catalog in all market places.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced people leader to join our rapidly growing team as a Manager II, Program Management. In this role you will build and lead a team of SMEs, auditors and Program Managers responsible for developing insights and eliminating quality defects that affect business metrics. You will own a portfolio of catalog quality programs rather than a single workstream, set the direction and mechanisms your team operates by, and be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business outcomes of the programs under you. As part of this role, you will 1\) hire, develop, and lead a team of auditors, SMES and program managers, growing the bench and the capability of the function, 2\) own a portfolio of quality programs, prioritizing across competing initiatives and allocating capacity to the highest impact opportunities, 3\) set the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that make your team's programs measurable and repeatable, and 4\) work collaboratively across partner teams (Science, PMs, Engineering, Business, etc.) and represent catalog quality program management to senior leadership across GCO and partner orgs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**As a Manager II, Program Management You Will**
* Build, lead, and develop a team of auditors, SMEs and program managers, owning hiring, performance management, coaching, and career growth
* Own catalog quality programs, setting priorities across competing initiatives and allocating team capacity to the highest impact work
* Establish the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that ensure your team's programs deliver measurable business and operational outcomes
* Be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business/operational metrics of the programs under your team
* Drive quantitative, data\-oriented decision making across the portfolio and champion the adoption of technology solutions and process improvements
* Communicate program progress, risks, and results to senior leadership, ensuring transparency and alignment with key business goals
* Identify systemic gaps across process areas and mobilize your team and stakeholders to resolve them
* Serve as an escalation point and senior partner for in\-house and customer teams across Science, Engineering, Product, and Business
* Ensure effective risk controls are developed and maintained across programs, with corrective actions that keep commitments on track and minimize losses
* Develop and influence new ideas, establishing procedures and practices that promote long\-term, scalable solutions in dynamic environments
* Drive continuous improvement and decision\-making strategies across the team and the broader function


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* 5\+ years of team management experience

title: SAP Project Manager
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 Own the end\-to\-end SAP and enterprise applications landscape for the organization. Drive digital transformation, process standardization, and operational excellence across manufacturing, supply chain, finance, and commercial functions. Identify and implement new technologies to leverage IT for business benefits. Act as the strategic partner to business leaders and the Sr. GM IT / CFO for all SAP\-related initiatives.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* **Strategy \& Governance**



  




* Define and execute the SAP roadmap aligned to business strategy, including S/4 HANA evolution, RISE / cloud strategy and integration with non\-SAP systems
* Establish governance frameworks for change management, release management, master data, security, and compliance (including DPDP Act and internal controls
* Drive process standardization and best practices across plants and business units, leveraging SAP standard functionality wherever possible



  




* **Delivery \& Operations**



  




* Lead end\-to\-end SAP implementations, upgrades, and migrations (ECC → S/4HANA, Greenfield / Brownfield), ensuring on\-time, on\-budget delivery with quality
* Oversee day\-to\-day operations of SAP and key business applications (ITIL/SDLC\-based), including incident, problem, and change management, and vendor
* Ensure seamless integration between SAP modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, QM, PM, WM/EWM, PS, etc.) and with MES, SCADA, PLM, BI, and other enterprise systems.



  




* **Manufacturing \& Domain Leadership**



  




* Partner with COO, Plant Heads, and Supply Chain leaders to align SAP architecture with production planning, capacity planning, shop\-floor automation, and MRP processes
* Provide deep expertise in discrete / process manufacturing concepts: BOMs, routing, work centers, production orders, quality inspections, maintenance plans, and cost controlling
* Drive digital manufacturing initiatives (e.g., shop\-floor data capture, IoT integration, advanced analytics, AI/ML, RPA) on SAP BTP and allied platforms



  




* **Team \& Vendor Management**



  




* Build and lead a high\-performing team of functional, technical, and basis consultants, as well as support staff; drive capability building and succession planning
* Manage relationships with system integrators, vendors, and partners, negotiating contracts, monitoring performance, and ensuring value realization



  




* **Risk, Security \& Compliance**



  




* Own application security, role design, SoD controls, and data protection in line with corporate policies and regulatory requirements
* Ensure audit readiness and support internal/external audits with appropriate documentation and controls



  




* **Reporting and Relationships**



  




* **Reports to:**
* Sr. GM (IT) / CFO



  




* **Direct reports:**
* SAP functional leads, technical leads, support managers, and project managers



  




* **Key stakeholders:**
* COO, Plant Heads, CFO, CHRO, Supply Chain Head, Quality Head, and external partners



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Qualifications \& Experience
* 15–20 years in SAP and enterprise applications, with at least 2 full\-cycle SAP implementations in complex manufacturing setups
* Strong hands\-on experience with SAP S/4 HANA (implementation and / or migration) and deep knowledge of core modules: FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, QM, PM; exposure to PS, WM /EWM, and Group Reporting is preferred
* Proven track record managing large teams (10\+) and multi\-plant, multi\-location rollouts



  




* **Education**
* Graduate or Postgraduate in Engineering, Finance, Marketing or Material Management



  





**Required Skills** 



* Skills and Competencies
* Domain: Manufacturing operations, supply chain, finance \& controlling, project systems, and plant maintenance
* Technical: SAP S/4HANA, ECC, SAP BTP, integration middleware, basic ABAP understanding, analytics (e.g., SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI, Superset / Grafana)
* Leadership: Strategic thinking, stakeholder management, negotiation, team building, and executive communication
* Transformation: Digital transformation, automation (RPA / AI), cloud strategies (SAP RISE), and continuous improvement mindset

title: Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 As CohnReznick grows, so do our career opportunities. As one of the world’s top professional services firms, and in support of our global workforce strategy, we’re growing our operations in India! We create rewarding careers in advisory, assurance, and tax with team members who value innovation and collaboration in everything they do!

Together, the firm provides leaders with deep industry knowledge and relationships, solutions to address clients’ unique business goals and risks, and insight on how emerging market forces can drive opportunity. With offices worldwide, the firm serves organizations around the world as an independent member of Nexia.

 **Manager** 
 to join the
 **Operating Partnership** 
 team in our
 **Tax** 
**practice** 
 .
   

  

 CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered hybrid which means team members are expected to be thoughtful and intentional in how they create opportunities for in\-person collaboration. While the cadence of in\-office presence is determined at the team level, our professionals are encouraged to be in the office/together in person on average 3 days a week.
   

  

**YOUR TEAM.**
 This position will support our
 **Tax** 
 team and this team Prepares and or Review US Federal Income tax returns of Partnership/ Form 1065 (
 **Operating Partnership)** 
 .
   

  

**WHY COHNREZNICK?**
 At CohnReznick, we’re united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Whether it’s working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your “why” at the firm.

We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning \& development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer.
   

  

**YOUR ROLE.**
**Responsibilities Include But Not Limited To**
* Manage U.S. federal and state tax engagements, including partnership / Form 1065 returns (Operating Partnership).
* Perform second\-level reviews and concurring reviews on complex tax returns and engagements.

* Work closely with senior management to provide regular updates on project status, risks, capacity constraints, and delivery challenges
* Collaborate closely with the Resource Management team to identify resource needs, manage assignments, and allocate work based on team capacity and availability.


**Your Experience.**
**The successful candidate will have:**
* Strong technical expertise in U.S. taxation and thorough understanding of accounting principles.
* Proven ability to manage multiple engagements, teams, and deadlines in a dynamic environment.
* Strong leadership skills with experience managing teams and mentoring staff.
* Advanced analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to assess risks and make informed decisions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, particularly with U.S. teams and senior leadership.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in accounting or related field.
* CPA/EA Qualification Preferred
* Minimum 7\+ years of relevant experience in U.S. taxation
* Experience with U.S. tax software such as CCH Axcess, Go\-System, OneSource, ProSystem, and CCH Engagement/CaseWare.


 In addition, please take a moment to review our
 **Universal Job Standards.**
 Studies have shown that we are less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification. At CohnReznick, we are dedicated to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or one of our other roles.
   

  

 "CohnReznick" is the brand name under which CohnReznick LLP and CohnReznick Advisory LLC and their respective subsidiaries provide professional services. CohnReznick LLP and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiaries) practice in an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable law, regulations, and professional standards. CohnReznick LLP is a licensed CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. CohnReznick Advisory LLC provides tax and business consulting services to its clients. CohnReznick Advisory LLC and its subsidiaries are not licensed CPA firms.
   

  

 CohnReznick is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive team to drive business results and create a better future every day for our team members, clients, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

**Job Description**
**Product Analyst – Job Description**
**Job Summary**
 The Business Analyst cum Product Analyst analyzes business systems, processes, and data to engineer solutions that enhance business capabilities and operational efficiency. As a core member of the product team, this role translates business workflows into clear technical requirements, specifications, and acceptance criteria. The analyst also functions as a proxy product owner and subject matter expert, collaborating closely with business stakeholders and technical teams. A strong foundation in requirements engineering, process modeling, Agile practices, and data analysis is essential.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Requirements \& Product Analysis**
* Translate business processes, goals, and terminology into technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Act as a proxy product owner for designated business domains, offering functional expertise and guidance.
* Collaborate with product owners, stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to analyze, document, and refine product requirements.
* Manage and prioritize product backlog items in Azure DevOps based on business value, dependencies, and stakeholder inputs.
* Prepare communications, presentations, and documentation on system enhancements, alternatives, and recommended solutions.


**Process \& Data Analysis**
* Analyze business workflows to identify opportunities for process improvement, efficiency gains, and automation.
* Validate, interpret, and analyze data from Mainframe environments, DB2 databases, and SQL queries to support decision\-making.
* Contribute to building business cases by gathering data, identifying issues, and documenting components under senior guidance.


**Agile Delivery \& Project Support**
* Support Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Develop schedules of tasks based on overarching project timelines and keep stakeholders informed on progress.
* Participate in system testing, UAT, and production validation to ensure solution accuracy and quality.

 **500\+ employees** 
 , each possessing rich field expertise. Metayb focuses on fostering seamless customer experiences, enhancing operational efficiency, and deriving actionable insights. By harnessing the power of emerging technologies, Metayb aims to be the unparalleled choice for global customers, delivering strategic goals effectively within a digital\-first ecosystem of value creation.
   

  

 Our key areas of expertise lie in
 **Digital Transformation, Data Science, SAP Implementation, Workflow Automation, Dashboarding, Visualization, Finance, and Supply Chain Services** 
 . We strongly aspire to venture into
 **IoT, AI/ML, and Virtual Reality** 
 . Metayb endeavours to be best\-in\-class across digital solutions, infrastructure, and product engineering.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Supply Chain Manager** 
 to manage and coordinate end\-to\-end
 **logistics, shipment planning, transportation, dispatch, and supply chain operations** 
 across the Middle East and Africa region, with a particular focus on
 **Saudi Arabia and Egypt** 
 .
   

  

 The role will focus on ensuring smooth shipment execution, timely deliveries, transportation management, supply chain visibility, and effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders. The position will work closely with the
 **Head of Logistics** 
 to provide operational support, maintain critical logistics information, monitor shipment progress, and proactively manage delivery risks and operational challenges.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in
 **logistics, transportation, dispatch, warehousing, and supply chain operations** 
 , along with strong SAP knowledge and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders across international markets.
   

  

 This role is based in
 **Chennai** 
 and operates on a
 **12:00 PM to 9:00 PM IST shift.**
 The working week is
 **Saturday to Thursday** 
 , with
 **Friday as the weekly off** 
 .
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 🔹 Shipment Planning \& Coordination
   

  

* Coordinate daily dispatch and shipment activities based on customer orders and delivery schedules.
* Plan and arrange transportation for shipments from factories to customer locations across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and other relevant Middle East and African markets.
* Work closely with the Head of Logistics to support day\-to\-day logistics planning, execution, and operational decision\-making.
* Act as an operational support and coordination point for the Head of Logistics, maintaining critical shipment, transportation, and logistics information.
* Ensure timely availability of vehicles, transportation resources, and logistics partners required for shipment execution.
* Maintain updated contact details and records of transport vendors, drivers, logistics partners, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Track shipments from dispatch through delivery and proactively identify, report, and resolve potential delays, disruptions, and delivery risks.
* Coordinate closely with warehouse teams to ensure packing, loading, documentation, and dispatch readiness.
* Maintain effective communication with internal teams and multi\-national stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of logistics operations.
* Maintain strong governance and visibility across the end\-to\-end supply chain and logistics process.
* Develop a strong understanding of business operations and ensure timely fulfilment of customer and business commitments.


 🔹 Transportation \& Logistics Management
   

  

* Manage and coordinate transportation activities across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and other Middle East and African markets.
* Liaise with transport vendors, third\-party logistics providers, drivers, warehouses, factories, and destination teams to ensure smooth shipment execution.
* Monitor vehicle movement, shipment status, delivery schedules, and transportation performance.
* Proactively identify transportation risks and coordinate appropriate corrective actions to minimise delivery disruptions.
* Resolve transportation delays, vehicle availability issues, and delivery\-related challenges in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure effective coordination between factories, warehouses, transporters, drivers, customers, and destination teams.
* Support effective management of freight, transportation resources, shipment tracking, and delivery performance.
* Maintain accurate records of transportation activities, shipment status, delays, and operational issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve transportation efficiency, service levels, and supply chain performance.


 🔹 Supply Chain Operations \& SAP
   

  

* Leverage strong SAP knowledge to support logistics planning, shipment execution, reporting, and day\-to\-day supply chain operations.
* Ensure timely and accurate updates of shipment and logistics information within relevant systems.
* Monitor supply chain activities and maintain visibility across the order, dispatch, transportation, and delivery cycle.
* Prepare and maintain logistics and supply chain reports covering shipment status, delivery performance, delays, transportation activities, and operational risks.
* Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure accurate flow of information across the supply chain.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and support initiatives focused on process improvement, supply chain efficiency, and operational governance.
* Ensure adherence to established processes, controls, and governance requirements across logistics operations.


 🔹 Stakeholder \& Vendor Management
   

  

* Maintain strong relationships with transport vendors, logistics partners, warehouse teams, factory teams, customers, and internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate effectively with stakeholders across different countries, cultures, and time zones.
* Serve as a key coordination point between the Head of Logistics and operational stakeholders.
* Ensure timely communication of shipment status, operational challenges, delays, and critical escalations.
* Escalate significant logistics and supply chain issues to the appropriate stakeholders with relevant information and recommended actions.
* Support effective stakeholder communication to ensure continuity and smooth execution of logistics operations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with logistics partners to support reliable transportation and service delivery.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 15–20 years of experience in logistics, transportation, dispatch, warehousing, or supply chain operations.
* Strong experience working in manufacturing, factory, warehouse, distribution, or FMCG environments.
* Extensive experience in shipment planning, transportation coordination, logistics operations, and supply chain management.
* Experience managing logistics operations across international or multinational markets is preferred.
* Candidates with strong exposure to Middle East and Africa logistics operations will be preferred.
* Arabic\-speaking candidates will be given priority.


**Required Skills**
* Strong understanding of transportation, logistics, distribution, and end\-to\-end supply chain processes.
* Strong hands\-on experience with SAP and proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Experience in logistics reporting, shipment tracking, freight management, and transportation coordination.
* Strong knowledge of dispatch planning, delivery management, warehouse coordination, and transportation operations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, coordination, and relationship management skills.
* Strong customer\-service orientation with the ability to manage internal and external relationships effectively.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities.
* High attention to detail with a strong focus on process governance, operational control, and supply chain visibility.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operational challenges in a fast\-paced, international environment.
* Strong ownership and accountability for shipment execution, delivery commitments, and logistics performance.
* Ability to work effectively with multi\-national teams and stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* Strong understanding of freight management and shipment tracking systems.
* Arabic language proficiency will be a significant advantage.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in the FMCG industry.
* Exposure to logistics and supply chain operations across the Middle East and Africa region.
* Experience managing shipments to Saudi Arabia, Egypt, GCC countries, or African markets.
* Experience working with international transportation vendors and logistics partners.

title: Senior Program Manager, RBS : Cost to Serve
description:
**Description**
 Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Retail Business Services (RBS) accelerates Amazon's growth by improving customer and Selling Partner (SP) experiences, while optimizing costs across Stores WW. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon's systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high\-quality customer and selling\-partner experience.
   

  

 Cost to Serve (CtS) is a specialized organization within RBS focused on improving Amazon's per\-unit economics across the global supply chain. CtS operates on two pillars: defect identification and defect elimination, and partners with WW Operations, Finance, Returns, Concessions, and abuse\-related programs to uncover true cost drivers and remove them systematically. The team builds mechanisms that improve cost predictability, strengthen upstream defect visibility, and enable consistent governance across high\-impact cost categories, contributing directly to improved Free Cash Flow and scalable business growth.
   

  

 Are you passionate about building AI\-powered cost intelligence solutions at scale? Amazon's RBS CtS organization is looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead our charter for identification of emerging cost trends, which serves as the first step in the journey of Defect Identification and contributes to the organization’s defect elimination work. This role serves as the primary business POC, engaging with RBS, Retail category, FBA and Finance teams in managing two projects (i) Project Strata, a layered analytical product built on a "peel the layers" philosophy that gives RBS and Stores leadership a unified, one\-stop view of how Cost to Serve is trending — decomposing headline P\&L costs into granular operational drivers and identifying cost opportunities through benchmarking between different time periods, MPs, channels and business lines. (ii) Defining and setting up P0 output and input metrics for RBS's UDE program. This role also serves as the primary POC to our tech partners in building and scaling above two projects and guides a team of Business Analysts who co\-develop and validate the MLP and scaled product's outputs.
   

  

 This leader will define requirements, own the working backward plan and oversee the daily mechanisms that connect business expertise to technical development. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable managing technical product delivery and presenting program health to Director\-level leadership, with the judgment to navigate ambiguity in a fast\-moving, high\-visibility space.
   

  

 Why You’ll Love This Role
   

  

* High Impact at Scale: You'll lead identification of emerging cost trends and drive investment by the Org in right cost areas.
* Build with Tech: Serve as the key business voice shaping an AI\-powered platform from the ground up, defining what good looks like and ensuring the tool meets the bar for downstream adoption.
* Leadership Visibility: Own updates to senior leaders on key organizational priorities, with direct influence on how the organization invests in automation long\-term.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Business/Tech Partnership \& Requirements Definition: Serve as the primary business counterpart to the analytics and tech teams.
* Working Backward Planning: Own the milestone delivery plan for above two projects. Identify risks early, adjust plans proactively, and maintain credible path\-to\-green narratives for leadership.
* BA Team Oversight: Manage the Business Analysts who develop MLP of the products. Iteratively capture feedbacks from Stores leaders and ensure the feedback mechanism runs smoothly, quality standards are maintained, and BAs are effectively translating domain expertise into product development.
* Quality \& Trade\-off Decisions: Hold a high bar on output quality. When design or quality blockers arise, make trade\-off decisions that balance speed, accuracy, and adoption — escalating to senior leaders for significant calls.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of managing stakeholders in cross\-functional project experience
* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Bachelor's degree


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of leading large complex programs experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field

**The opportunity**
 The internal capability lead MTS is responsible for building, internalizing, and scaling a new operating model for high voltage switchgear that enables sustainable growth in a rapidly expanding market.
   

  

 In the first phase, the role partners closely with an external consulting company that is driving to redesign the business execution model. title: Supplier Assurance Project Manager
description:
**Job Title: Supply Chain Assurance Manager – Pacific (Australia and New Zealand)**
 ISS connects people and places to make the world work better. Are you ready to connect to a place where you belong? At our corporate facilities or at client sites – together, we make places while transforming businesses into having even more positive impact on societies, the environment, and our people.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Guindy, Chennai, India
   

  

**Language:** 
 English
   

  

**Main purpose of the position:**
 ISS is looking for dynamic individuals in the supply chain, risk and assurance function to drive CUSTOMER VALUE by securing assurance of subcontractors that provide compliance services to ISS.
   

  

 We’re delighted to be recruiting for a new Supply Chain Assurance Manager to join the ISS Procurement Excellence team. This role will be predominantly working with our Australia and New Zeeland team and Group Supply chain assurance team. Working with suppliers and subcontractors who are aligned with ISS and its customers’ values is critically important to us; the Supply Chain Assurance team drive supply chain compliance with ISS standards and policies on our key customer accounts. You will be responsible for supplier relationship management. Reporting to the Assistant General Manager of Supply Chain Assurance, you will play a key role in adding value to our customer accounts in the Australia and New Zealand, minimising risk exposure via the implementation, delivery, and reinforcement of supplier management processes.
   

  

 You will work cross\-functionally to ensure effective supplier management and strong relationships with both ISS functions and countries (Australia and New Zealand).
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Supplier Relationship Management: Ensure focus with material supplier(s), that delivery is consistent, aligned to scope and quality assured.
* Ensure supplier performance is monitored at defined intervals, and corrective actions are implemented to address performance gaps.
* Creation of supplier contracts with flow\-down terms and conditions for our material suppliers in Australia and New Zeeland providing services to Key Accounts \- liaising with the supplier, Country Legal, the ISS customer account management team and Country Procurement category teams where appropriate. Negotiate terms, pricing and set KPIs and manage the contracts through to signing.
* Work in collaboration with the Vetting team and group assurance team to ensure compliance for suppliers in the assurance programme
* Manage ‘material’ suppliers to complete any client specific requirements
* Conduct audit support activity – introduction meeting including presentation, pre\-audit documentation, collaborate with supplier to close gap closure items and submit relevant documentation for closure
* Management of action plans for our key customer accounts, to incorporate defined standards of compliance with the Group Supply Chain \& Procurement supplier assurance programme
* Managing and reporting on performance by all parties per supplier assurance activity
* Routinely re\-communicating the supplier assurance programme parameters and its importance to all stakeholders and securing their continued buy\-in
* Support as required for wider supplier assurance activities, Procurement Excellence projects, and Supply Chain \& Procurement objectives


**Ideal Candidate**
* Previous employment in Supply Chain Management, Supplier Assurance or Procurement (typically 5\+ years), or strong corporate background in other professional services within a large organisation
* Degree level education or professional qualification (e.g., CIPS) is highly desirable
* Demonstrable experience in stakeholder/relationship management skills
* Strong business acumen, with negotiation skills (experience of working with contracts is highly desirable)
* Organised, thorough, and diligent work ethic; a desire to take ownership of tasks and deadlines, executing activities without micromanagement


**Who you’ll work with:**
* Key Account Director / Key Operation Directors – ensure in first instance Compliance Services are managed effectively.
* Critical and Strategic Suppliers (Key contacts)
* Interact with senior ISS stakeholders in establishing a fact base for implementing and driving performance management of suppliers and subcontractors
* Interact with our customers to define, deliver, and update on the assurance progress and enable a risk
* Drive results through working with country procurement, operations organizations and subcontractor.


**Personal skills you excel:**
* On a personal level, you are structured and demonstrates energy, persistence, and determination in the implementation of projects and initiatives.
* You are diplomatic and persuasive and demonstrates good understanding of the general business principles.
* Moreover, you have great interpersonal skills in building relationship and networking with both internal and external stakeholders.
* Knowledge of Technical Services


**Why ISS**
 Since our founding in 1901, ISS has been a people\-first company. We recognize the power of diversity and celebrate the differences that make us unique. When everyone is free to be themselves, everyone benefits. Our people feel safe, respected, represented, and supported as their authentic selves, allowing them to seize opportunities and reach their full potential. We take seriously our obligation to improve lives, make a difference in our communities, and protect our planet — because when we get things right, the world works better. And that is what drives us.
   

  

**ISS is a Place to Be You.**
 Be who you are. Become what you want. Be part of something bigger.
   

  

 Become more.
 **Become ISS.**
**How You’ll Apply**
 Apply directly via the link on this page by submitting a cover letter, CV and other relevant documents for the position you are applying for.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application as soon as possible.
   

  

**ISS seeks to BE a place of belonging and CREATE places where every person is welcomed, embraced, and valued for exactly who they are. Places where people feel safe, respected, represented, and supported as their authentic selves.**

description:
Senior Project Lead
   

  

 Project and Development Services – (Chennai/India)
   

  

 What this job involves:
   

  

 Leading projects to success
   

  

 As Senior Project Lead you’ll take total responsibility for the overall success of major
   

  

 projects—guiding teams in each phase to achieve outcomes that exceed clients’
   

  

 expectations and meet JLL’s commercial objectives. Driven and ambitious by nature, you
   

  

 have a mastery of the ins and outs of business—from products and systems to processes,
   

  

 tools and best practices. You’ll need to collaborate effectively with a range of stakeholders,
   

  

 leading from the front while also taking the time to understand their point of view.
   

  

 For each project, you’ll establish an effective organisational structure for reporting,
   

  

 communication and working procedures, and ensure that clear objectives and quality
   

  

 control systems are in place. You’ll lead a project team that is highly motivated, eager to
   

  

 contribute, and in sync with the stakeholders’ mind\-sets. You’ll also attend project
   

  

 meetings, submit monthly reports, and monitor project budgets, so an eye for detail and a
   

  

 structured approach to tasks will serve you well.
   

  

 Making clients our first priority
   

  

 The best person for this job is one who always considers what’s best for our clients. As
   

  

 such, you’ll maintain a strong and positive relationship with our clients by identifying
   

  

 their needs, requirements and constraints. While you act in the clients’ best interests
   

  

 throughout the project duration, you must make sure that the project’s revenue and
   

  

 payment cycles are properly managed.
   

  

 Keeping an eye on business opportunities is also among the highlights of the job. Do you
   

  

 have a knack for building rapport with prospects? Your expertise in surveying a client’s
   

  

 needs and supporting the preparation of PM proposals is key. Likewise, skilfully
   

  

 developing relationships with other company business lines is a must; we achieve are
   

  

 biggest success when working together, so clear communication is key, as is
   

  

 collaboration and team work.
   

  

 Maintaining the JLL legacy
   

  

 We uphold excellence in everything we do—that has been essential to our more than 200
   

  

 years of staying power. As the person in charge, your task is to continue our tradition of
   

  

 project success. You’ll accomplish this by creating a network of professional consultants
   

  

**Who Can Deliver The Required Scope Of Every Project.**
 Likewise, you’ll handle contract administration of all vendors professionally and according
   

  

 to legal requirements. It’s the best way to protect both our and the clients’ commercial
   

  

 interests. Your expertise will also be central in identifying project risks and mitigating
   

  

 them. Furthermore, you’ll be responsible for developing project\-related reports, analyses
   

  

 and reviews regularly.
   

  

 Sound like you?
   

  

 Our successful Project Managers ...
   

  

 Engage confidently with internal and external stakeholders and see things from their
   

  

 perspective.
   

  

 Are driven to succeed and love achieving challenging goals.
   

  

 Bring a structured and organised approach to everything they do.
   

  

 Communicate and collaborate to achieve success.
   

  

 Thrive under pressure and deal effectively with tight deadlines and high expectations.
   

  

 To apply you need to be:
   

  

 Project\-smart and technology\-savvy
   

  

 We employ talent from a wide range of backgrounds, though typically you should have a
   

  

 degree in any property\-related discipline, and at least 10 to 12 years’ experience in
   

  

 design, construction or project management.
   

  

 Are you technology savvy? As the digital leader in project management, we use a range
   

  

 of technology platforms to deliver our projects.
   

  

 Do you have a deep understanding of the legal environment for each project in respect to
   

  

 planning, commercial aspects, and delivery? If your answers are ‘yes’, then you’re already
   

  

 one step ahead.
   

  

 A natural communicator
   

  

 This role calls for superior communication skills, as we’ll expect you to be able to handle
   

  

 complex conversations with business owners, senior executives, and decision makers. We

 times. Of course, you’ll be good at building team relationships and interacting effectively

 What we can do for you:
   

  

 At JLL, our purpose is to shape the future of real estate for a better world.
   

  

 We make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your

 ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits
   

  

 package.
   

  

 Apply today!

+ Comfortable moving between granular tracking work and a high\-level status conversation, and increasingly able to judge which the moment needs.

title: Program Manager II (Cost To Serve), RBS : Cost To Serve
description:
**Description**
 Are you passionate about solving business challenges at a global scale? Amazon Retail Business Services is looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join our team and help unlock insights which take our business to the next level. The candidate will be excited about understanding and implementing new and repeatable processes to improve our employee global work authorization experiences. They will do this by partnering with key stakeholders to be curious and comfortable digging deep into the business challenges to understand and identify insights that will enable us to figure out standards to improve our ability to globally scale this program. They will be comfortable delivering/presenting these recommended solutions by retrieving and integrating artifacts in a format that is immediately useful to improve the business decision\-making process. This role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities as well as business acumen. The candidate knows and values our customers (internal and external) and will work back from the customer to create structured processes for global expansions of work authorization, and help integrate new countries/new acquisitions into the existing program. They are experts in partnering and earning trust with operations/business leaders to drive these key business decisions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the development and maintenance of new and existing artifacts focused on analysis of requirements, metrics, and reporting dashboards.
* Partner with operations/business teams to consult, develop and implement KPI’s, automated reporting/process solutions, and process improvements to meet business needs.
* Enable effective decision making by retrieving and aggregating data from multiple sources and compiling it into a digestible and actionable format.
* Prepare and deliver business requirements reviews to the senior management team regarding progress and roadblocks.
* Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions.
* Design, develop and maintain scaled, automated, user\-friendly systems, reports, dashboards, etc. that will support our business needs.
* Excellent writing skills, to create artifacts easily digestible by business and tech partners.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and Drive Business Goals: Lead strategic initiatives to reduce Cost to Serve (CtS) across key areas, including inventory defects, shipping costs and operational inefficiencies. Own the lifecycle of these initiatives, from problem definition to solution implementation, with limited leadership direction.
* Data\-Driven Decision\-Making: Use advanced analytics tools to uncover inefficiencies, analyze cost and volume drivers, and develop actionable solutions. Drive detailed discussions based on data insights and align cross\-functional teams on high\-priority initiatives.
* Financial Collaboration: Partner with finance teams to validate cost models, forecast savings and ensure alignment with Amazon’s financial goals. Make trade\-offs between short\-term cost reductions and long\-term strategic objectives to maximize financial impact.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across finance, operations and supply chain to implement scalable solutions. Unblock teams to increase speed of delivery and ensure alignment on program goals.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Conduct deep dives into defects to identify systemic inefficiencies, leveraging frameworks like Upstream Defect Elimination (UDE). Influence technology decisions and external entity interactions to resolve complex, undefined problems effectively.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate effectively with senior leaders, presenting data\-driven insights and recommendations to influence decision\-making. Trusted to present decisions to leaders up to three tiers above level, driving alignment across diverse areas.
* Scalable Solutions: Develop and implement scalable programs across geographies, incorporating regional nuances and best practices.


**About The Team**
 Cost to Serve (CTS) aims to identify and eliminate waste, negative experiences, and non\-value activities across the end\-to\-end remit of supply chain and dependent workstreams that slow down resolution for our stakeholders. The primary objective is to reduce Cost To Serve for Amazon and enable “Free Cash Flow” by optimizing the Cost per shipped unit economics across the supply chain systems. Our program will support in establishing the end\-to\-end supply chain checkpoints on how the inventory moves inside Amazon to identify gaps, broken processes/policies to eliminate root causes of systemic difficulties rather than merely addressing symptoms, on behalf of our customers. This team will partner with internal/external stakeholders to establish the FCF/Cost to serve charter based on opportunity size and own specific unique initiatives that are beyond the existing team’s program scope.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Project Coordinator - Interior
description:
**Company Description** 
 Dotand is a multidisciplinary architecture and design studio with offices in Chennai, Calicut, and Bhubaneshwar, focused on shaping spaces that balance functionality, innovation, and timeless appeal. The studio works across commercial, residential, educational, institutional, research, medical, industrial, hospitality, retail, and corporate projects, maintaining a unified design vision across diverse typologies. Its approach emphasizes contextual understanding, precise detailing, and collaborative creativity to ensure that each project reflects both purpose and identity. Dotand is committed to creating environments that inspire, endure, and feel genuinely connected to the people who use them.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Project Coordinator – Interior (full\-time, on\-site in Chennai) will support the planning and execution of interior design projects from concept through completion. This role involves coordinating project schedules, tracking deliverables, and assisting with documentation such as drawings, reports, and presentations. The Project Coordinator will liaise with design teams, vendors, contractors, and clients to ensure clear communication and timely progress on site activities. Responsibilities include organizing meetings, preparing minutes, managing material samples and approvals, and monitoring quality and adherence to design intent. The role also requires proactive problem\-solving, maintaining project records, and supporting the interior design team in achieving project milestones within scope, time, and budget.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Coordinate day\-to\-day activities of interior projects from initiation to completion.
* Coordinate with the project manager, site engineers, architects, designers, vendors, and contractors.
* Prepare and maintain project schedules, trackers, and progress reports.
* Monitor project progress and ensure activities are completed as per the planned timeline.
* Coordinate site requirements, material procurement, deliveries, and vendor schedules.
* Follow up with vendors and contractors for quotations, material samples, drawings, and execution requirements.
* Maintain project documentation, drawings, approvals, purchase orders, and other records.
* Coordinate with the design team to ensure drawings and specifications are available at the site.
* Track project\-related issues and coordinate with the concerned teams for timely resolution.
* Assist in preparing project status reports and updating management on project progress.
* Coordinate client meetings, site meetings, and project discussions when required.
* Ensure proper communication between the office and site teams.
* Monitor material availability and highlight potential delays or shortages.
* Support the project team in maintaining quality, timelines, and cost control.
* Ensure all project\-related documents and records are properly maintained.


 Requirements
 * Bachelor's degree/Diploma in
 **Civil Engineering, Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field** 
 .
* 3–6 years of experience in
 **interior fit\-out/project coordination** 
 .
* Good knowledge of interior execution processes, materials, and site activities.
* Strong coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and follow up effectively.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, Excel, and project tracking tools.
* Ability to read and understand drawings and project documents.
* Strong organizational and problem\-solving skills.
* Willingness to coordinate with site teams and travel to project locations when required.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPI)
 * Timely completion of assigned project activities.
* Effective coordination between office, site, vendors, and contractors.
* Accuracy and timely updating of project trackers and reports.
* Timely material and vendor follow\-ups.
* Reduction of project delays caused by coordination gaps.

* Client and internal team satisfaction.

title: Learning Content Producer – 3D & Video
description:
Hexr Factory is a next\-generation immersive technology company and an Unreal Engine Authorized Service Partner — redefining how businesses and teams turn ideas into reality through powerful, real\-time digital experiences.
   

  

 We don’t just build products — we engineer dynamic, interactive ecosystems that transform complex concepts into compelling, high\-impact solutions. From cutting\-edge digital twins and advanced simulations to fully interactive platforms, our work enables sectors such as AEC, real estate, automotive, edtech and enterprise to visualise, communicate and operate with exceptional clarity and accuracy.
   

  

 At Hexr, innovation is at the core of everything we do. Our multidisciplinary team blends deep interactive realtime 3D expertise with leading\-edge software engineering, design thinking and high\-fidelity visualization to deliver visually striking, technically robust experiences across web, desktop and mobile environments.
   

  

 This is a place for ambitious thinkers and problem\-solvers — people who want to push boundaries, build meaningful technology and create experiences that don’t just look good, but truly make an impact.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a Learning Content Producer – 3D \& Video to own day\-to\-day planning and delivery across digital\-learning content production. The role turns approved scripts, storyboards and animatics into structured, trackable production plans and coordinates the complete content pipeline—from 3D assets, animation and lighting through video, voice\-over, subtitles, review and quality control—to ensure work is delivered on time, at the required quality, and ready for formal review and delivery.
   

  

 You will work closely with the Creative Director, Project Head, instructional designers, storyboard artists, 3D artists, animators, editors, QA teams, language and voice teams, vendors and relevant stakeholders. This is a hands\-on delivery leadership role: the focus is dependable execution, clear ownership, early risk visibility and disciplined follow\-through.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Build and maintain master schedules for content units, segments, shots and deliverables.
* Break briefs and scripts into clear tasks, dependencies, owners, estimates, milestones and review gates.
* Track daily production across scripting, storyboarding, animatics, 3D, animation, lighting, rendering, video editing, audio, subtitles, translation and QA.
* Coordinate handoffs between creative, technical, production and quality teams so work does not stall between stages.
* Maintain a single source of truth for status, blockers, priorities, due dates, feedback, revisions and next actions.
* Monitor workload and capacity, identify bottlenecks early, and recommend practical reallocation or sequencing changes.
* Run concise production reviews and stand\-ups, document decisions and follow up until actions are closed.
* Establish and enforce internal quality gates; ensure only complete, checked and approved work moves to formal review or delivery.
* Review progress and output readiness across multiple teams without replacing specialist creative or technical ownership.
* Coordinate external vendors and contract teams, including briefs, handoffs, follow\-ups, review cycles, corrections and delivery commitments.
* Prepare clear status reports covering progress, risks, dependencies, resource constraints, decisions required and recovery actions.
* Communicate with internal and external stakeholders professionally, escalating risks with options and evidence.
* Support realistic planning during peak delivery periods while protecting quality, ownership and sustainable workload.
* Maintain organised production records, trackers, references, approvals and version history.
* Handle work materials with discretion and confidentiality.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* 5–10 years of experience in production, delivery, project coordination or program operations within digital learning, animation, media, gaming, VFX, interactive content or related industries.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and delivering multiple content streams or recurring deliverables.
* Strong understanding of digital learning and content production workflows, including scripts, storyboards, animatics, 3D and animation, video, audio, subtitles, review and QA.
* Proven ability to build schedules, manage dependencies, maintain trackers and drive closure of blockers.
* Practical experience with quality gates, review cycles, feedback management and delivery\-ready outputs.
* Strong workload planning, prioritisation, risk management and escalation skills.
* Experience coordinating vendors, contract teams or distributed production teams.
* Strong written and spoken communication in English is required. Ability to read and write Hindi fluently is mandatory.
* Comfortable working with Excel or Google Sheets and project or task\-tracking tools such as ClickUp, Jira, Asana, Trello, ShotGrid, fTrack or equivalent.
* Ability to work from the Chennai workspace on a full\-time, on\-site basis.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail and ability to operate calmly under delivery pressure.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in e\-learning, educational video, animation, 3D production or game\-engine\-based workflows.
* Familiarity with subtitles, dubbing or voice\-over, language review and localisation workflows.
* Experience with production dashboards, reporting, SOPs, QC checklists or process improvement.
* Experience managing high\-volume, repetitive content delivery with consistent quality.
* Relevant education in project management, media, animation, digital learning, design, technology or an equivalent practical background.
